# Certificate Studio v0.0.6

**App version:** `0.0.6+10`.

This release improves the certificate designer and adds new contact and PDF-sharing options.

## Highlights

- **Contact fields:** Support for typed phone and link fields in certificate data.
- **PDF sharing:** Share generated PDF files through WhatsApp.
- **Designer:** Improved drag alignment so fields track the pointer accurately.
- **Arabic support:** Release packages are built with Arabic support enabled.

## Downloads

Packages are available for Android phones, and desktop versions for Linux (AppImage and DEB), macOS (DMG), and Windows (installer EXE).
